name: Hemolytic Anemia Due to a Disorder of Glycolytic Enzymes

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Glycolytic Enzyme Deficiency Hemolytic Anemia

criteria.description: Demonstration of reduced activity of a glycolytic enzyme (e.g., pyruvate kinase) in erythrocytes
Presence of chronic hemolytic anemia with reticulocytosis and indirect hyperbilirubinemia
Exclusion of other causes of hemolytic anemia such as membrane defects and hemoglobinopathies
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes encoding glycolytic enzymes
Positive family history consistent with autosomal recessive or dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Reduced erythrocyte glycolytic enzyme activity plus clinical and laboratory evidence of chronic hemolytic anemia with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can confirm diagnosis but is not mandatory if enzyme assay and clinical features are conclusive.
